These deliberate checks and synthesis do not establish purposeless duplicated work.

The artifact handoff is inconsistent: [M6] (AgentTrace turn #6) reports writing B; [M7] (AgentTrace turn #7) then claims the file is D and says no further action is needed from Executor, but [M8] (AgentTrace turn #8) reports the file still holds B, fails it, and requests restoration. Thus the announced D state did not reliably reach the verification handoff and required corrective coordination in [M10] (AgentTrace turn #10). [M11] (AgentTrace turn #11) and [M12] (AgentTrace turn #12) later confirm recovery to D; recovery does not erase the earlier handoff mismatch.

The visible B/D disagreement is resolved rather than left unintegrated: [M4] (AgentTrace turn #4) explicitly revises Planner's C2 assumption; [M8] (AgentTrace turn #8) and [M10] (AgentTrace turn #10) address Executor's B rationale; [M12] (AgentTrace turn #12) withdraws that rationale, and [M11] (AgentTrace turn #11) passes D. [M13] (AgentTrace turn #13) requests another verdict without incorporating that PASS, but its near-concurrent placement alone does not establish a clear opportunity to use it.
